'''Childar''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Republic Army]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], selling combat gear during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Childar first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a [[Quesh]] planetary commendation vendor on board Carrick Station.<ref name="TOR" /> He was later removed from the game.
